issues.before: BASS AIR readings could not contribute to numerical flow matching because calibration was not applied.
issues.cause: Calibration workbook had not been connected to the table adapter.
issues.fix: Only one positive AIR reading uses source cell A33 formula U=1.0066 AIR after exact workbook hash verification; Fan and changing readings excluded.
issues.verification: B1 real data 5→5.033 cm/s; missing/changed calibration gate and variable-reading tests; context dependency SHA checked.

issues.before: PMMA sheet measurements in the report were available as a PDF but not structured numerical results.
issues.cause: CSV-only adapters did not extract report tables.
issues.fix: 20 source rows from Table5.1, with geometry and measured spread separated from matching score; no zero substitution for untracked results.
issues.verification: All20 rows visually checked; M1 .071 mm/s, two untracked cases, multi-stage isolation and live dataset checks.

issues.before: A complete percentage could be produced without selected specimen kind.
issues.cause: Only material and weighted parameter coverage were mandatory.
issues.fix: Require same selected specimen kind too; one/two burning sides is an exact optional filter.
issues.verification: Unknown geometry gives no overall percentage; wrong specimen/side excluded; same values retain arithmetic score.

issues.before: 100% could be read as all-condition equivalence even when based on one selected criterion.
issues.cause: Headline omitted the count of weighted criteria.
issues.fix: Show selected criterion count and source-specific expandable measurement/provenance detail.
issues.verification: Final portable browser screenshot and DOM checks.

issues.before: Universal physical weights and critical risk thresholds are not validated.
issues.cause: Effects differ by material, geometry, flow regime, and the defined outcome.
issues.fix: No fabricated scientific weights; user draft preserved, empirical observations shown separately. Engineering roadmap records per-domain models and independent validation.
issues.verification: No critical-risk label, no automatic operational commands, no live provider call.
